core_claim.quote: consciousness depends on biologically ‘orchestrated’ coherent quantum processes in collections of microtubules within brain neurons

source.citation: Hameroff S, Penrose R. Consciousness in the universe: a review of the 'Orch OR' theory. Physics of Life Reviews 11(1):39-78, 2014

prediction.statement: Quantum coherence (many parts of a system sharing one quantum state) will be detected in microtubules.

first_stated.passage: Experiments with SQUIDs (superconducting quantum interference devices) such as those suggested by Leggett (1984) will detect phases of quantum coherence in microtubules.

prediction.test_against: Measurements sensitive enough to detect quantum coherence in microtubules at body temperature find none, or find that it is lost far faster than any biological process (for example in under a millionth of a second).
